title: 人口分布与迁移
lead: 世界人口并非均匀铺开，而是聚集在温带近海的平原与大河沿岸；推动其增减与流动的，是自然条件与经济机会的双重引力。
leadEn: World population is far from even—it clusters on temperate, coastal plains and great river valleys, shaped jointly by natural endowment and economic pull.

points.v: 东亚、南亚、欧洲与北美东部构成几大稠密区，荒漠、寒带与高山则地广人稀。
points.vEn: East and South Asia, Europe and eastern North America are dense; deserts, polar and alpine zones are sparsely peopled.

points.v: 气候、水源、地形等自然基底，叠加就业、收入与公共服务等经济拉力。
points.vEn: A natural base of climate, water and terrain, overlaid by economic pulls of jobs, income and services.

points.v: 从乡村到城市的国内迁移，与跨越国界的国际移民，动机含务工、求学与避难。
points.vEn: Rural-to-urban domestic moves and cross-border international migration, driven by work, study and refuge.

points.v: 社会从高出生高死亡走向低出生低死亡，中间的人口红利与老龄化影响深远。
points.vEn: Societies shift from high birth/death to low birth/death; the intervening demographic dividend and ageing matter greatly.

sources.label: 联合国《世界人口展望》；人口地理学综述
sources.labelEn: UN World Population Prospects; population geography syntheses

title: 城市化与城市体系
lead: 人口与经济活动向城市持续集聚，既重塑地表景观，也形成由全球城市到中小城镇的等级体系。
leadEn: People and economic activity keep clustering in cities, remaking the landscape and forming a hierarchy from global cities to small towns.

points.v: 以城镇人口占总人口比重衡量城市化水平，速度可与经济发展阶段脱节。
points.vEn: Urbanization is gauged by the share of urban population; its pace can outpace or lag economic development.

points.v: 就业机会、规模经济与完善基础设施吸引人口流入，形成集聚效应。
points.vEn: Jobs, economies of scale and dense infrastructure draw inflows, creating agglomeration effects.

points.v: 少数全球城市居于顶层，下接区域中心城市与庞大的中小城镇网络。
points.vEn: A few world cities sit at the top, above regional hubs and a broad web of smaller towns.

points.v: 住房紧张、交通拥堵、环境退化与贫富分区是快速扩张的常见代价。
points.vEn: Housing pressure, congestion, degradation and segregated poverty are common costs of rapid growth.

sources.label: 联合国《世界城市化展望》；城市地理学经典
sources.labelEn: UN World Urbanization Prospects; urban geography classics

title: 聚落形态与乡村景观
lead: 人类的居所既有沿河沿路铺展的线状村舍，也有围绕水井庙宇团聚的村落——形态记录着水源、地形与生产方式。
leadEn: Human dwellings range from linear hamlets along rivers and roads to nucleated villages clustered round a well or temple—form records water, terrain and livelihood.

points.v: 集村紧凑、分散民居疏朗，前者常见于灌溉农业区，后者多现于牧业与山地。
points.vEn: Nucleated villages are compact, dispersed farmsteads sparse; the first suits irrigated farming, the second herding and uplands.

points.v: 靠近水源、避开洪患、背风向阳与交通便利是传统聚落选址的共同准则。
points.vEn: Near water, safe from floods, sheltered from wind, sun-facing and well-linked—shared rules of traditional siting.

points.v: 平原村落密集规整，山区聚落零散依山，水乡则以河为街、以桥为门。
points.vEn: Plain villages are dense and orderly, mountain hamlets scattered on slopes, water towns use rivers as streets and bridges as gates.

points.v: 城市边缘的郊区带兼具两类特征，是耕地流失与通勤居住最活跃之地。
points.vEn: The fringe blends both, where farmland is lost fastest and commuting living expands.

sources.label: 乡村地理学与聚落形态研究
sources.labelEn: Rural geography and settlement morphological studies

title: 农业区位与土地利用
lead: 种什么、在哪里种，由光热水土的自然禀赋与距市场远近的经济账共同决定，形成各具特色的农业地域类型。
leadEn: What and where to grow is set by the natural gift of light, heat, water and soil together with distance to market, yielding distinct regional farming types.

points.v: 气候决定熟制与作物种类，地形影响机械化，水源灌溉与土壤肥力制约单产。
points.vEn: Climate fixes cropping seasons and species, terrain shapes mechanization, while water, irrigation and fertility cap yields.

points.v: 杜能圈以运距与地租解释环绕城市的农业带分布，易腐作物近城布局。
points.vEn: Thünen's rings explain farm belts around a city by haul distance and rent; perishables sit nearest.

points.v: 季风水田农业、商品谷物农业、混合农业、大牧场放牧业与园艺业分处不同环境。
points.vEn: Monsoon paddy, commercial grain, mixed farming, ranching and horticulture each occupy distinct settings.

points.v: 过度开垦与灌溉不当引发水土流失、盐碱化与荒漠化，威胁可持续利用。
points.vEn: Over-cultivation and poor irrigation bring erosion, salinization and desertification, threatening sustainable use.

sources.label: 杜能《孤立国》；农业区位论综述
sources.labelEn: Von Thünen, The Isolated State; agricultural location syntheses

title: 工业区位与产业转移
lead: 工厂选址权衡原料、能源、市场与劳动力成本；随比较优势变迁，产业在区域间不断梯度转移，重绘世界经济地图。
leadEn: Plants weigh raw materials, energy, markets and labor cost; as comparative advantages shift, industries step down across regions, redrawing the economic map.

points.v: 原料指向、市场指向、动力指向与劳动力指向，决定不同类型工业的聚集地。
points.vEn: Material-, market-, power- and labor-oriented pulls each anchor different industry types.

points.v: 相关企业地理集中可共享基础设施与配套，降低成本并激发创新。
points.vEn: Geographic clustering lets firms share infrastructure and suppliers, cutting costs and sparking innovation.

points.v: 劳动密集型环节从发达地区转向成本更低的承接地，呈雁行梯度推进。
points.vEn: Labor-intensive stages migrate from rich regions to lower-cost hosts, advancing in a flying-geese gradient.

points.v: 从资源粗加工走向技术密集与绿色制造，是传统工业区的再生之路。
points.vEn: Moving from bulky resource processing to high-tech and green manufacturing is the renewal path of old industrial districts.

sources.label: 韦伯《工业区位论》；产业转移研究
sources.labelEn: Weber, Theory of the Location of Industries; relocation studies

title: 交通与通讯网络
lead: 铁路、公路、航线与光缆编织成流动的网络，压缩时空、连接市场，也决定哪些地方繁荣、哪些被绕开。
leadEn: Rails, roads, air routes and fiber weave flowing networks that compress space and time, link markets, and decide which places thrive and which are bypassed.

points.v: 水运廉价运量大、铁路连续性强、公路灵活门到门、航空迅捷、管道专运流体。
points.vEn: Shipping is cheap and capacious, rail steady, road flexible door-to-door, air swift, pipelines dedicated to fluids.

points.v: 港口、铁路交会点与航空枢纽因转运功能兴起，成为城市成长的引擎。
points.vEn: Ports, rail junctions and air hubs rise on transshipment, becoming engines of urban growth.

points.v: 提速与降本拉近了遥远市场的距离，使生鲜与零部件得以全球当日达。
points.vEn: Faster, cheaper travel shrinks distant markets, letting perishables and parts cross the globe within a day.

points.v: 互联网与光纤让信息几近免费流动，重塑商业、城市与远程工作格局。
points.vEn: The internet and fiber move information near-free, reshaping business, cities and remote work.

sources.label: 交通地理学与网络经济研究
sources.labelEn: Transport geography and network economics studies

title: 贸易与商业空间
lead: 商品从产地经批发、零售的层级流向消费者，贸易通道的兴衰塑造了港口、集市与城市的地理命运。
leadEn: Goods flow from origin to consumer through wholesale and retail tiers; the rise and fall of trade routes shapes the geographic fate of ports, markets and cities.

points.v: 中心地理论解释城镇作为服务中心的等级、数量与腹地范围。
points.vEn: Central place theory explains towns as service centers in a hierarchy of rank, number and hinterland.

points.v: 资源制成品互补,发达国家与发展中国家沿比较优势展开产业内与产业间贸易。
points.vEn: Raw and finished goods complement one another; advanced and developing economies trade both across and within industries.

points.v: 从丝绸之路到大航海、苏伊士与巴拿马运河，新通道改写沿岸城市的繁荣。
points.vEn: From the Silk Road to the Age of Sail and the Suez and Panama canals, new routes recast the wealth of port cities.

points.v: 从集市、百货到购物中心与电商，商业空间不断向线上与社区两端迁移。
points.vEn: From bazaars and department stores to malls and e-commerce, retail keeps migrating online and back to the neighborhood.

sources.label: 克里斯塔勒《中心地理论》；商业地理综述
sources.labelEn: Christaller, Central Places in Southern Germany; commercial geography syntheses

title: 文化区、语言与宗教
lead: 语言、宗教、习俗与建筑在空间中聚合成文化区；它们的扩散、叠加与碰撞，构成人文地理最生动的图层。
leadEn: Language, religion, custom and architecture coalesce into cultural regions; their diffusion, overlap and clash form geography's most vivid layer.

points.v: 以语言、宗教或生产方式的相对均质边界划分，边界多为过渡带而非直线。
points.vEn: Drawn on the relative homogeneity of language, faith or livelihood, their edges are transition zones rather than lines.

points.v: 扩张扩散、迁移扩散与层级扩散，让观念、作物与创新沿路径传播。
points.vEn: Expansion, relocation and hierarchical diffusion carry ideas, crops and innovations along routes.

points.v: 语系分布与三大一神教等信仰版图深刻影响地名、建筑与区域认同。
points.vEn: Language families and the great monotheisms shape place-names, buildings and regional identity.

points.v: 田垄、庙宇、街巷与饮食皆为人所书写的景观，可读出一个群体的历史。
points.vEn: Fields, temples, streets and food are landscapes written by people, legible as a group's history.

sources.label: 萨帕尔·文化地理与景观研究
sources.labelEn: Sauer, cultural geography and landscape studies

title: 政治地理与国界
lead: 领土、国界与地缘格局划定权力的空间；国家的形状、位置与资源，深刻影响其战略选择与国际角色。
leadEn: Territory, borders and geopolitics map power onto space; a state's shape, position and resources deeply shape its strategy and world role.

points.v: 天然界沿山河荒漠划定，人为界以经纬线或民族语言为据，常埋争端。
points.vEn: Natural bounds follow rivers, ranges and deserts; artificial ones use meridians or ethnicity, often sowing dispute.

points.v: 紧凑、狭长或破碎的领土影响交通、治理与分裂主义的风险。
points.vEn: Compact, elongated or fragmented territory affects transport, governance and separatist risk.

points.v: 海权与陆权之争、边缘地带学说，尝试以空间解释大国博弈。
points.vEn: Sea- versus land-power and the rimland thesis try to explain great-power rivalry through space.

points.v: 从地方选区划分到区域一体化与全球化，权力在不同空间尺度上重组。
points.vEn: From local gerrymandering to regional integration and globalization, power is reorganized across spatial scales.

sources.label: 麦金德与豪斯霍弗地缘政治；政治地理综述
sources.labelEn: Mackinder and geopolitical theory; political geography syntheses

title: 发展差异与经济地理
lead: 财富与产业在空间上高度不均，发达与发展中地区的差距，由历史、制度、区位与资源共同书写。
leadEn: Wealth and industry are starkly uneven in space; the gap between advanced and developing regions is written by history, institutions, location and resources.

points.v: 人均 GDP、产业结构、人类发展指数等指标共同刻画发展水平。
points.vEn: GDP per capita, sectoral structure and the Human Development Index together depict development level.

points.v: 核心区与边缘区的收入、就业与基础设施落差，在一国内部同样显著。
points.vEn: Core–periphery gaps in income, jobs and infrastructure are as sharp within countries as between them.

points.v: 内陆锁定、疾病、教育与资本匮乏相互强化，使部分地区难以起飞。
points.vEn: Landlocked-ness, disease, weak schooling and thin capital reinforce each other, stalling takeoff.

points.v: 出口导向、进口替代、资源开发与人力资本投入构成不同的赶超策略。
points.vEn: Export orientation, import substitution, resource booms and human-capital investment offer distinct catch-up strategies.

sources.label: 世界经济地图与人类发展报告
sources.labelEn: World economic mapping and Human Development Reports

title: 全球化与空间联系
lead: 资本、商品、信息与人口的跨境流动把世界缝合成一张网络，既带来效率与互联，也制造依赖与失衡的赢家输家。
leadEn: Cross-border flows of capital, goods, information and people stitch the world into one network—delivering efficiency and connection, yet breeding dependence and uneven winners and losers.

points.v: 贸易、投资、移民与数据流相互叠加，构成全球空间经济骨架。
points.vEn: Trade, investment, migration and data flows stack into the skeleton of the global spatial economy.

points.v: 少数节点指挥跨国公司与金融，形成金字塔式的全球城市等级。
points.vEn: A few nodes command multinationals and finance, forming a pyramidal world-city hierarchy.

points.v: 一件产品的设计、零部件与组装分布于多国，形成全球价值链。
points.vEn: A single product's design, parts and assembly scatter across countries into a global value chain.

points.v: 全球连通放大机会也激化竞争，地方以特色产业与文化认同作出回应。
points.vEn: Global links magnify opportunity but sharpen rivalry; places respond with niche industries and cultural identity.

sources.label: 弗里德曼《世界是平的》；全球化地理研究
sources.labelEn: Friedman, The World Is Flat; globalization geography studies

title: 人地关系与可持续发展
lead: 人类适应并改造环境，也反受其制约；如何在发展与承载之间求衡，是贯穿人文与自然的地理核心命题。
leadEn: Humans adapt to and remake the environment, yet remain bound by it; balancing development against carrying capacity is geography's central question spanning nature and society.

points.v: 从环境决定论到人地协调与可持续发展，认知不断从单向走向互动。
points.vEn: From environmental determinism to harmony and sustainability, understanding has moved from one-way to interactive.

points.v: 水土、能源与生物资源的过量索取，逼近地球系统的承载极限。
points.vEn: Over-drafting of water, soil, energy and biological resources pushes toward the planet's carrying limits.

points.v: 气候变化、灾害与污染使脆弱地区承受不成比例的风险与损失。
points.vEn: Climate change, disasters and pollution impose disproportionate risk and loss on the vulnerable.

points.v: 循环经济、清洁能源与国土空间规划，寻求代际与区域的公平。
points.vEn: Circular economy, clean energy and spatial planning seek fairness across generations and regions.

sources.label: 布伦特兰《我们共同的未来》；可持续发展目标
sources.labelEn: Brundtland, Our Common Future; Sustainable Development Goals
